text: Provisions hereof shall apply to Personal Data when it is electronically processed, or obtained, gathered or extracted in preparation in any other way for electronic processing, or when processed via a combination of electronic and traditional processing.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Provisions hereof shall not apply to Personal Data processed by individuals within a private or a family scope, or to any Personal Data processed for the purpose of obtaining official statistical data as per provisions of the referred to law No (2) of 2011.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Withdraw the prior consent thereof for Personal Data Processing.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Object to processing the Personal Data thereof if such processing is not necessary to achieve the purposes for which such Personal Data have been collected or where such collected Personal Data are beyond the extent required, discriminatory, unfair or illegal.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Request omission or erasure of the Personal Data thereof in any of the cases referred to in the preceding two items , upon cessation of the purpose for which the processing has been conducted, or where all justifications for maintaining such Personal Data by the Controller cease to exist.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Request corrections to the Personal Data thereof. A request so made shall be accompanied with proof of the accuracy of such request.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Be notified of processing the Personal Data thereof and the purposes for which such processing is conducted.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Be notified of any disclosure of inaccurate Personal Data.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Obtain a copy of the Personal Data thereof after paying an amount that shall not exceed the service charge.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Processing Personal Data honestly and legitimately.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Consider the controls related to designing, changing or developing products, systems and services pertinent to Personal Data Processing.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Taking appropriate administrative, technical and financial precautions to protect Personal Data, in accordance with what is determined by the Competent Department.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The privacy protecting policies developed by the Competent Department, and a decision thereon shall be issued by the Minister.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Controller's details or any other party conducting the processing for the Controller or to be used thereby.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Lawful Purposes that the Controller or any other party wants to process the Personal Data therefor.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Comprehensive and accurate description of the processing activities and the levels of disclosure of such Personal Data for the Lawful Purposes, and if the Controller fails to do so, the Controller shall provide the Individual with a general description thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Any other information that is necessary and required for fulfilling conditions of Personal Data Processing.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Reviewing privacy protection measures before proceeding with new processing operations.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Identifying Processors responsible for Personal Data protection.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Training and raising awareness of Processors on protecting personal data.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Developing internal systems to receive and investigate complaints, and data access and omission or correction requests; and they shall be made available to individuals.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Developing internal systems for the effective management of Personal Data, and reporting any breach of measures aiming at the protection thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Using appropriate technologies to enable individuals to exercise their rights to directly access, review and correct their respective Personal Data.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Conducting comprehensive audits and reviews on the compliance extent with Personal Data protection requirements.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Verifying Processor's compliance with the instructions directed thereto, taking the appropriate precautions to protect Personal Data, and monitoring and following-up the same constantly.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Each of the Controller and the Processor shall take the precautions necessary to protect Personal Data against loss, damage, change, disclosure, access thereto, or the inadvertent or illegal use thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Such precautions shall be commensurate with the nature and the importance of the Personal Data intended to be protected.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Processor shall forthwith notify the Controller of the existence of any breach of the precautions referred to, or where any risk arises threatening Personal Data in any way.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Personal data, related to ethnic origin, children, health, physical or psychological condition, religious creeds, marital relations, and criminal offenses, shall be regarded as Personal data with special nature.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Minister may add other types of Personal Data of a special nature, where the misuse or disclosure of the same may cause serious damage to Individual.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Personal Data of a special nature may only be processed after obtaining the permission from the Competent Department, as per the measures and controls determined by a decision issued by the Minister.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Minister may, upon a decision therefrom, imposing additional precautions with the intent of protecting Personal Data of a special nature.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Posting a notification on the website as to what child data is, the way of its use, and the policies followed in the disclosure thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Obtaining, either electronically or through any other appropriate means, an explicit consent from the guardian of the child whose Personal Data is processed.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Providing a child's guardian, upon the request thereof, and after verifying the identity thereof, with a description of the type of the Personal Data processed, along with stating the purpose of the process together with a copy of the data processed or gathered about the child.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Deleting, removing or suspending processing any Personal Data that has been gathered from or about a child, if such is requested by child's guardian.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: A child's participation in a game, promotional award or any other activity shall not be conditional on the child's provision of Personal Data in excess of the necessary for the participation in such activity.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Protecting National and public security.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Protecting international relations of the State.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Protecting the economic or financial interests of the State.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Preventing any criminal offense, or gathering information thereon or investigating therein.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Competent Authority shall keep a special record where the data achieving the aforementioned purposes shall be entered. Conditions, controls and statuses of entry on such record shall be specified by virtue of a decision issued by the Minister.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Executing a task related to the public interest as per the law.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Implementing a legal obligation or an order rendered by a competent court.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Protecting vital interests of Individual.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Achieving purposes of scientific research which is underway for public interest.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Gathering necessary information for investigation into a criminal offense, upon an official request of investigative bodies.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: When disclosure would cause harm to commercial interests of another individual.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: When implementation of such liability would cause disclosing Personal Data related to another Individual who does not consent thereto, and disclosure may lead to physical or moral damage either to this Individual or to any other Individual.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The transmission of any Electronic Communication to an Individual, for the purpose of Direct Marketing, shall be forbidden, except after obtaining the prior consent thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Electronic Communication shall include the identity of the originator thereof, and highlight that it is sent for the purpose of Direct Marketing.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: In addition, it shall include a valid address for easy access thereto and through which an Individual can send a request to the originator to stop such communications or revoke the consent on the sending thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: An Individual may file a complaint to the Competent Department in case of violating provisions hereof and the issued decisions in the implementation thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Competent Department may, after investigating received complaints and proving the seriousness thereof, issue a reasoned decision binding the Controller or Processor, as the case may be, to rectify such breach within a period it specifies.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Controller or Processor may raise a grievance against such decision to the Minister, within sixty days from the notification date thereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: The Minister shall decide on the grievance within sixty days from the date of the submission thereof, and the lapse of such period without a response shall be considered as an implicit rejection of the grievance, and the decision of the Minister thereon shall be final.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Coordinating with any professional group or association, and any other association representing Controllers or Website Operators for the purpose of self-organization encouragement and development, and raising awareness of this Law and developing training and learning programs.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Working with organizations and societies interested in family affairs to enhance the safety of children on the internet.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Conducting researches and monitor developments in technology's fields related to issues covered by this Law, and preparing reports or recommendations on the same.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Parties falling under provisions hereof shall, within six months from the date of the effectiveness thereof, adjust their conditions in line with provisions hereof.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf

text: Such period may be extended for other similar period or periods by virtue of a decision of the Council of Ministers, upon the proposal of the Minister.
source_document: KB 2/Qatar/Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.pdf
